title: Books by People bets on drafts to certify human-written books
teaser: Books by People has received approval from the UK Intellectual Property Office to distribute a mark certifying that a book was written by a human. The British startup is pitching a check based on authors’ drafts and research materials, not just AI-detection software, as publishers face renewed scrutiny over whether books on their shelves were written by people. Five publishers have joined the project, and the company expects the first marked book before the end of the year.
